text: 《中华人民共和国金融法（草案）》11月2日提请十四届全国人大常委会第二十五次会议二次审议。草案二审稿充实金融消费者、投资者保护内容，并对互联网营销等活动增加针对性规定。
text_en: The draft Financial Law of the People's Republic of China was submitted on November 2 for a second review at the 25th session of the 14th National People's Congress Standing Committee. The second draft expands provisions on financial consumer and investor protection and adds targeted rules on activities such as internet marketing.
